instructions: Use js for persistent Node JavaScript with top-level await and redeclarable bindings. Use dynamic import(); static imports and node:process are unavailable. nodeRepl.write(value) emits text; await nodeRepl.emitImage(dataUrl or {bytes,mimeType}) emits an image. nodeRepl.cwd, homeDir, tmpDir and requestMeta expose this execution context. This is a real Node kernel, separate from Code Mode.

tools.name: js
tools.description: Use js for persistent Node JavaScript with top-level await and redeclarable bindings. Use dynamic import(); static imports and node:process are unavailable. nodeRepl.write(value) emits text; await nodeRepl.emitImage(dataUrl or {bytes,mimeType}) emits an image. nodeRepl.cwd, homeDir, tmpDir and requestMeta expose this execution context. This is a real Node kernel, separate from Code Mode. Default timeout_ms is 30000; timeout or cancellation resets the kernel.

tools.name: js_reset
tools.description: Reset the JavaScript kernel and clear all bindings. Added node_modules directories remain available.

tools.name: js_add_node_module_dir
tools.description: Add an absolute node_modules directory for package imports. The directory remains available after js_reset.
